theme_archetype.description: Cinematic, moody, and expensive. Uses deep graphite and navy tones layered with elegant typography and high contrast frost white text. Generous whitespace, calm, confident, asymmetrical.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-display font-light tracking-tight text-equine-platinum
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-display font-light tracking-tight text-equine-platinum
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-equine-lilac

layouts_and_spacing.global_spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for major sections.
layouts_and_spacing.role_cards_grid: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6). Example: Card 1 (col-span-4), Card 2 (col-span-2). Use gap-8.

hero.layout: Single hero, elegant and confident. Clear headline + subhead.
hero.classes: min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.overlay: bg-equine-graphite/60 or gradient overlay to ensure text contrast over background image.
hero.ctas: Primary CTA 'Join Equine Sync' (bg-equine-platinum text-equine-graphite font-medium px-8 py-4). Secondary 'Sign in' (text-equine-lilac hover:text-equine-platinum transition-colors).

trust_strip.classes: flex flex-wrap justify-between md:justify-center gap-8 md:gap-16 py-8 border-y border-white/5 bg-equine-navy/30

role_cards.style: bg-equine-navy/50 border border-white/5 backdrop-blur-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 group cursor-pointer

pricing_band.card_style: bg-equine-navy/40 border border-white/5 p-8 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden
pricing_band.most_popular: For $49 tier. Add a subtle 1px border-equine-lilac/50 and a soft glow. Add a 'Most Popular' overline badge (bg-equine-lilac/10 text-equine-lilac px-3 py-1 text-xs tracking-wider font-body absolute top-6 right-6).

signup_wizard.layout: Centered narrow container (max-w-2xl) inside a py-20 section.
signup_wizard.step_indicator: 3-step visual progress. Use text-equine-lilac for active step, text-white/20 for upcoming.
signup_wizard.step_1: Account basics: Name, Email, Phone, Password, Location, Role pick. Role pick should use custom Shadcn select or styled radio cards.
signup_wizard.step_2: Role-specific fields. Include a distinct 'Skip & complete later' pill/button (variant='ghost' text-equine-lilac hover:bg-equine-navy/50).
signup_wizard.step_3: Membership tier selection (compact cards) + Stripe checkout visual placeholder.
signup_wizard.classes: bg-equine-navy/80 border border-white/10 p-10 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl

pending_review_banner.layout: Fixed top or inline prominent banner.
pending_review_banner.classes: bg-equine-navy border-l-4 border-equine-lilac p-4 flex items-center gap-4 mb-8

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1). Subtle border brightness increase.
interactions_and_motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for role cards and pricing using Framer Motion.

hero_background.description: Grayscale elegant horse rider, use as a subtle dark background with overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build using React (.js files, NOT .tsx) and Tailwind CSS.
Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors (equine-graphite, etc.) and fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Inter).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (e.g., checkmarks in pricing).
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations.
Ensure all interactive elements and forms have `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components and strip away generic Vercel-like styles to match the luxury dark theme.
Implement the landing page at `/` and the signup wizard at `/signup`.
